text:
nora: Hi team — considering moving to Dublin with my partner for ~7 months (2026-10-01 -> 2027-04-01). Question: should I declare this as temporary homebase or pursue a permanent relocation? Partner may take a local contract while I do some local recruiting/interviews for hires. Also wondering about WFH stipend, whether we can ship household boxes vs just equipment, and how benefits/payroll will change if partner is on a local contract.
people-ops: Hey @nora — good to flag early. Short answers: 1) >6 months often falls into the 'relocation' bucket in our policy, not the 'temporary remote' one. 2) recruiting/interviews + partner working locally increases nexus risk and will trigger a deeper payroll/tax review. 3) stipend/relocation shipping differ — shipping household goods uses the relocation workflow and caps; equipment-only uses temporary shipping.
global-mobility: If you're >6 months and bringing household goods, submit the Relocation Intake form (https://redwood.company/forms/relocation) instead of the Homebase Change form. We'll coordinate visa/immigration and relocation vendors. Relocation allowance rules apply (moving quotes, inventory, customs).
tax-eng: Important: local recruiting and your partner's local contract both materially raise permanent establishment and employment nexus risk. Ireland has specific employer-facing rules; >6 months + hiring activity may require local payroll registration or EOR routing. We'll need full details: will you be conducting interviews on behalf of Redwood (scheduling, debriefs, offers)? Will any offers be extended locally?
nora: I would be doing technical interviews and debriefs, and might help coordinate local hiring logistics. Partner will be on a 6-month contract for a local company unrelated to Redwood. No offers will be signed in-person without HQ approval.
people-ops: Noted. Because you'll exceed 6 months and will conduct hiring activity, we'll likely escalate to our tax partner. Expect a recommendation in ~3 business days about whether Redwood should route payroll via EOR or register locally.
payroll-ops: FYI: if routed via EOR we may need to change payroll currency/withholding which can affect your 401(k contributions and benefits enrollment timelines. We'll surface the implications before any switch. If kept on USD payroll, your WFH stipend and 401(k) continue as usual but local tax/social contributions might be required.
hr-benefits: For benefits: US medical remains primary while on USD payroll but routine care abroad isn't covered. If you shift to local payroll, medical and pension rules change. Child/dependent benefits (if any) depend on local enrollment rules. We can check global medical rider eligibility and quote private family travel medical plans if needed.
it-ship: Shipping household goods vs equipment: household moves require relocation vendor (quotes, pick-up/door-to-door shipping) and are under the relocation cap. Equipment-only shipments (laptop, monitor) are handled by `#it-ship` under temporary shipping policy. Customs for household goods are more complex — relocation vendor usually handles paperwork.
people-ops-bot: Policy update: "Relocation vs Temporary Remote" guidance (FAQ + decision tree) available: https://redwood.company/policies/relocation-vs-temp-remote. Tip: >180 days strongly leans relocation path; hiring activity increases nexus risk.
people-ops: Action items for @nora: 1) confirm whether you want to treat this as relocation (household move) or temporary (equipment only), 2) if relocating, submit Relocation Intake form and upload passport + partner contract copy, 3) we'll queue tax partner review and share payroll implications within 3 business days.
nora: Thanks — I'll submit the Relocation Intake form and upload partner contract. Prefer Redwood to handle relocation vendor sourcing (pre-approved vendor). Also please pre-approve shipping quotes if possible.
tax-eng: We'll start the nexus assessment once forms are in. Preliminary note: with your described activities we'll likely recommend local payroll registration or EOR routing for Ireland for the 7-month period. We'll confirm with external counsel.
people-ops: Great — closing loop: @nora submit Relocation Intake, we'll coordinate global-mobility, tax, payroll, benefits, and `#it-ship`. We'll post updates here as we get vendor quotes and the nexus opinion. :white_check_mark:
